{{Quote|This is our recreation of the beloved childhood favorite, prepared with freshly ground ettel nuts and gourmet Andorian jelly. Served on bleached pseudograin bread.|Dex's Diner menu, on the deluxe nutmeat and jelly sandwichh|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Deluxe nutmeat and jelly sandwich''' was a type of [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Costing 4.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], it was prepared with freshly ground [[ettel nut]]s and gourmet [[Andorian jelly/Legends|Andorian jelly]] and served on bleached [[Pseudograin bread]]. According to [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery's]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]], the sandwich was a childhood favorite among many patrons. It was sold as part of the diner's [[Foodstuff/Legends|lunch]] favorites<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> 

==Behind the scenes==
Deluxe nutmeat and jelly sandwiches were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
